title: Device identity (hub -> integration)
description: Everything the integration needs to name and configure the HA user of one paired device. HA user name = '<brand> · [<guest label> ][<owner_label> ]<display_name>'; HA local_only = not remote_allowed. remote_allowed is the effective profile rule remote_access: guests may have it; a device with parental controls never has it. is_guest=true requires a guest_expires_at.

remote_allowed.description: Device may use HA from outside the local network: the effective profile rule remote_access. Default false (local-first); also for guests when their profile allows it and for devices with parental controls (read-only key, docs/enforcement.md §7).

guest_expires_at.description: Guest expiry (UTC). The integration bounds the HA-side token lifetime to expiry + 7 days grace and rotates the token when an extension is no longer covered.
